about: Requirements the resolver (engine/scripts/resolve_models.py, zylch/llm/roles/resolver.py) turns into the snapshot (snapshot.json: every catalogue model's price and request metadata) and, once measured.json covers every role, the decision record (table.json): roles declare a rule and an index, never a model and never a typed floor (thresholds come from measured.json). Prices are USD per million tokens; a preset ceiling bounds the catalogue output price of every ranked model. reference is the measurement's reference model (brief D7). At run time the engine reads the published table.json and snapshot.json (zylch/llm/roles/distribution.py), and on MrCall credits runs the first ranked id the billing server serves (zylch/llm/roles/served.py): mrcall_served, 10a's client-side copy of the server's catalogue, is gone. The allowlist, 10a's billed prices, went with resolved.json at the switch-over: the price source (zylch/llm/roles/prices.py) reads the snapshot, which prices every catalogue model.
_about_policy: Resolver v2 (milestone 10): excluded_families are matched as a vendor (the part of a catalogue id, canonical_slug or alias target before the first '/') plus a token contained in the part after it; margin multiplies a model's reference price (the snapshot's pricing: the model-level catalogue price whenever an eligible endpoint is priced within it x margin, else, for a fixed model-level price only, the lower median of its eligible endpoints by Artificial Analysis's blended price) into OpenRouter's max_price and the reservation, and bounds the endpoints admitted; provider_policy.quantizations admits endpoints by declared quantization (one that declares none is 'unknown'); excluded_endpoint_variants are service tiers never admitted (a segment of the endpoint tag after the provider).
_about_reference: The reference of every role's measurement: the production model, run by its adapter (K3 at max effort); every role's bootstrap arms include it.
